keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Barcelona 1, Newcastle United 0. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Fermín López.
Goal! Barcelona 1, Newcastle United 1. Anthony Elanga (Newcastle United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Lewis Hall with a through ball.
Joelinton (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Barcelona 2, Newcastle United 1. Marc Bernal (Barcelona) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Gerard Martín with a headed pass following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Barcelona. Ronald Araujo replaces Eric García.
Goal! Barcelona 2, Newcastle United 2. Anthony Elanga (Newcastle United) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Harvey Barnes.
Pau Cubarsí (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Kieran Trippier (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Barcelona 3, Newcastle United 2. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
First Half ends, Barcelona 3, Newcastle United 2.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Tino Livramento replaces Kieran Trippier.
Goal! Barcelona 4, Newcastle United 2. Fermín López (Barcelona) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Raphinha with a through ball.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Joe Willock replaces Sandro Tonali because of an injury.
Goal! Barcelona 5, Newcastle United 2. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) header from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Raphinha with a cross following a corner.
Joe Willock (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Barcelona 6, Newcastle United 2. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lamine Yamal with a through ball.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Sven Botman replaces Joelinton.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Jacob Murphy replaces Anthony Elanga.
Substitution, Barcelona. Xavi Espart replaces João Cancelo.
Substitution, Barcelona. Ferran Torres replaces Robert Lewandowski.
Substitution, Barcelona. Dani Olmo replaces Fermín López.
Goal! Barcelona 7, Newcastle United 2. Raphinha (Barcelona) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Newcastle United. William Osula replaces Anthony Gordon.
Substitution, Barcelona. Wojciech Szczesny replaces Joan García because of an injury.
Second Half ends, Barcelona 7, Newcastle United 2.
